scope: Serial loopback HTTP benchmark: aligned V2 SQL in local PGlite versus one-shot local Python CP-SAT. Not live PostgreSQL/Supabase, remote solver transport, or the production flight API.

timingBoundaries.calculation: Full capacity function call only; excludes process/module startup and IPC/HTTP. Python monotonic high-resolution timer; SQL clock_timestamp wrapper.
timingBoundaries.completeRequest: Client monotonic timer before request JSON encoding through HTTP response receipt, parsing and expected-result check. Includes server file input loading, input validation, engine invocation, Python startup/IPC, independent result validation and loopback HTTP transport.
timingBoundaries.serviceStartup: Fresh measurement service launch through ready HTTP listener, recorded separately; database initialization/schema installation are not charged to HTTP request time.
timingBoundaries.cold: First request to a fresh API process and (for SQL) newly initialized PGlite instance; not OS-cache-cold.
timingBoundaries.warm: One validated warm-up then repeated requests to the same API/database session. Solver still launches a fresh Python worker per request, matching the existing one-shot adapter.
timingBoundaries.excluded: Live database reads, authentication, production baggage preparation, WAN transport, external service hosting, UI/browser and deployment-wide concurrency.
